data.long_meaning: The name Luwaihah is derived from the Arabic word 'luwa' meaning soft or gentle, and 'hah' meaning life. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes the delicate nature of life and the importance of treating it with care and tenderness. The name Luwaihah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Luwaihah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
